FAQs

Can InvoiceWala auto-generate invoice numbers?

Yes. Saved invoices can use automatic invoice number generation.

Can I edit the invoice number?

Yes. You can choose your own invoice number when needed.

What is a good format?

Simple formats like INV-0001 or FY26-0001 are easy for small businesses to manage.
